title: Count Number of Nice Subarrays
summary: Given an array of integers, count how many continuous subarrays contain exactly k odd numbers.
statement: Given an array of integers, count how many continuous subarrays contain exactly k odd numbers.
constraints: Return the number of contiguous subarrays containing exactly k odd values.
reference_solution:
def count_nice_subarrays(nums, k):
 counts={0:1};odd=answer=0
 for value in nums:odd+=value%2;answer+=counts.get(odd-k,0);counts[odd]=counts.get(odd,0)+1
 return answer

hints: Map each prefix odd-count to how often it occurred.
At current count c, earlier prefixes c-k begin valid subarrays.
Add their frequency, then record c.
Subtracting equal prefix counts leaves exactly k odds.
